notes.title: Xbox 360 / PC controller
notes.notes:
1. connect your controller to PC before running the game
2. launch the game
3. go to options
4. press enter on "KEYBOARD" or just click it with LMB (under the sound options) and then it will change to "JOYSTICK"

Now you can play Top Hat on your gamepad.
